links.outcome: Accuracy of ChatGPT medication instructions versus official IFU/MG and pharmacist evaluation
links.effect: ChatGPT identified all medications; CountVec average text similarity 76%; pharmacist review found significant gaps and lower clinical accuracy for complex administration routes.
links.quote: However, clinical evaluation revealed significant gaps in the instructions, particularly for complex administration routes, where ChatGPT's guidance lacked essential details, leading to lower clinical accuracy scores.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of a multimodal generative AI model (ChatGPT vision) in generating medication administration instructions from drug images compared to official labeling, evaluated by text similarity and pharmacist review without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
